segments.comment: Independent dungeon.c u_on_newpos() and do.c goto_level() witness: a debug Valkyrie maps level 1, teleports onto its down stairs and descends, drops wished gold on the level-2 up stairs and rocks beside them, climbs back up, becomes hallucinated through #wizintrinsic, and descends again. On arrival u_on_newpos() calls map_location(), which draws the hallucinated gold's random glyph from the display RNG; goto_level() then calls docrt() alone. The rocks in view show any shift in that stream. The seed and clock were chosen independently of the example games.
